items.title: Intrinsicness of the local properties of modules on a site under passage to an equivalent topos
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that each of the properties (1)-(8) defining the local behaviour of a module on a site is intrinsic, i.e. invariant under the equivalence of topoi induced by a special cocontinuous functor. The proof transports the data along that equivalence: it sets O' = g_*O with the identity structure map and F' = g_*F, and reduces each property P_l to the corresponding global property P_g on the target site, which is already known to be intrinsic, so that only the equivalence P_l(C,O,F) iff P_l(D,O',F') must be checked (proof lines 3214-3236). The bulk of the proof verifies this equivalence property by property, and the coherent case is handled at the end by a finite type argument on a kernel (proof lines 3325-3332). H2: the transport of each local property across the topos equivalence, and the closing finite type argument for coherence, are the substance of a long but written-out verification.
